Standard office hours are 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM, with up to 30 minutes of flexibility.
Complete eight hours each day, including a 30-minute lunch break.
Take lunch from 1:00 PM to 1:30 PM, unless you are attending a client meeting or visiting a site.
Get approval in advance if you need to work overtime at the office.

Leave entitlements
Casual leave is 12 days per year.
Medical or sick leave is 12 days per year.
Public holidays follow the company’s annual holiday calendar.
If you take leave immediately before and after a weekly day off or public holiday, the intervening day also counts as leave.
For example, if you take leave on Saturday and Monday, Sunday also counts as leave.
Requesting leave
Request planned leave at least seven working days in advance.
For emergency or medical leave, notify the office as soon as possible. Leave approval depends on project and work requirements.
Leave deductions and reimbursement
Leave deductions are applied to your monthly salary.
Leave deductions are reimbursed every six months, in January and July, subject to your applicable leave balance.
Site visits and travel
On days when you travel by train or bus, only regular working hours count. The travel itself does not count as overtime.
Only site visits outside regular working hours count as overtime.
Notice period
Give 30 days’ notice before leaving the company, unless the company decides otherwise.
Salary
Salary is paid on the 7th of each month.
